data.one_liner: Creates and manages security-scoped bookmarks to retain macOS sandbox file access across launches
data.what_it_does: Provides macOS desktop apps with the ability to create security-scoped bookmarks for files picked by users. It enables apps to resolve stored bookmarks across app restarts to regain sandboxed file access, managing access lifecycles and tracking stale paths. It also supports volume display names and stale bookmark rewrites when files are moved or renamed.
use_when: Building a sandboxed macOS Flutter app that needs persistent file access across app relaunches
Preserving access to user-selected files on external drives or arbitrary folders in macOS App Sandbox
Handling stale bookmark resolution and scope management when files are renamed or moved
avoid_when: Developing for non-macOS platforms or apps that run outside the macOS App Sandbox
Apps that only need temporary file access during a single session without persisting access
strengths: Handles stale bookmarks by automatically providing refreshed bytes when target files move or rename
Provides per-ID security scope management to cleanly enter and release file access
Returns typed UnresolvableBookmark errors with native NSError domain and code details
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration of macOS sandbox entitlements to function
data.setup_notes: Requires enabling com.apple.security.app-sandbox, com.apple.security.files.user-selected.read-write, and com.apple.security.files.bookmarks.app-scope entitlements in both DebugProfile.entitlements and Release.entitlements.
